highlights.title: Jensen Huang says there is '0% chance' AI destroys the world by 2030 — 'We should go as fast as we can, irrespective of anyone else,' dismisses Anthropic doom warnings and rejects new regulations
highlights.description: Chief executive of Nvidia claims that fears that AI will destroy humanity in the coming years are unsubstantiated as safety mechanisms can preserve that.

highlights.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang emerges as Trump's top ally in AI safety debate
highlights.description: Jensen Huang's position as the leader of the world's most valuable company, has earned him Trump's ear on the most important topics in AI.

highlights.title: T. rex teeth indicate it ran as warm as an elephant
highlights.description: Isotope ratios provide a hint that the giants were actively managing temperatures.

highlights.title: An undercover Google analyst infiltrated a notorious supply-chain hacking gang
highlights.description: Google’s threat intelligence group said it had a mole inside TeamPCP's inner circle.

highlights.title: China to Step Up Curbs Against Malicious Price Competition
highlights.description: China will step up scrutiny of malicious price competition, including cost investigations and price inspections of companies that engage in such practices, the State Administration for Market Regulation said at a State Council Information Office briefing on Sunday.

highlights.title: Google's simulated fruit fly brain 'mines Bitcoin' in web browser proof of concept — FutureBit says real organic neuron miner could have '10x the efficiency of the best silicon 3nm ASICs'
highlights.description: A project claimed to represent 'the first organic neuron Bitcoin miner based on the fly brain' has gone live.

highlights.title: Meta's Muse Is Better at Surveilling Than Helping Me
highlights.description: The Muse app continues Meta’s trend of opting users into data collection for AI training. It also nudges you to share your bank account, email, and passport information.

highlights.title: Meet the Academics Trying to Stop You From Having Sex in Robotaxis
highlights.description: “You know ‘Bang Bus’? We don’t want that.”

highlights.title: Tiny Hairs That Help Corals Breathe May Malfunction in Warming Oceans
highlights.description: Several new studies have uncovered this long overlooked aspect of coral physiology that could be the key to the animals’ fate in a changing climate.

highlights.title: Australia’s Albanese Urges World to Act for Humanity in AI Race
highlights.description: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said middle powers have an important role to play in mitigating the risks posed by artificial intelligence and called for cooperation between the US and China.
